about: Hard points and groups of the 1929 sedan for the drawing board (review 32). x in mm from the front bumper. A: front of the front door; B: front door's rear edge; C: rear door's rear edge; Q: where the rear door would end with no quarter window (4-light); K: the front of the rear wheel block (everything behind it moves with the rear axle). Seam and handle positions are the body's side-view units.
